prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) has been helpful overall (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests, underestimating their actual performance.
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that showed no clear effect or performed poorly.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +4.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.4% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Redesigns the pick friend screen to a spotlight layout with focused pet view cards and animation preview. (why: Grid layout redesign was stopped previously, but spotlight layout focuses on one pet at a time, making choice less overwhelming.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen: Redesigns the path selection screen with a story scroll layout contrasting ready-made pet adoption with custom AI creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; story scroll layout presents both options clearly in a structured narrative format.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Two-Column Layout Redesign for Sign-In Screen: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a two-column layout separating account creation and existing user login. (why: 8 support emails complained of missing pets when signing into wrong or duplicate accounts; two-column layout clarifies login options.)
3: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen: Redesigns the home intro screen into a stage layout showing the active pet ready on the desktop. (why: Finish step takes median 395s / mean 5815s; stage layout immediately confirms pet readiness and reduces post-onboarding confusion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines Card: Adds explicit photo clarity and lighting hints to the upload photos screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to poor input photos.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Wait Time Estimate and Notification Toggle: Displays live progress timer, time estimate, and a ready notification toggle during pet creation. (why: Home waiting step averages 2336 seconds; progress feedback and ready notifications prevent users from abandoning during wait.)
6: [adoption, layout] Interactive Care Commitment Checklist on Adoption Certificate: Changes adoption certificate screen to a checklist layout where users review care commitments before finalizing. (why: 3 support emails asked how to control or hide pets after onboarding; checklist format sets expectations before completion.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns previously showed a negative effect (-8.0%) in tests.
Choose path redesign previously yielded +5.4% lift and addresses long mean duration.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails), though sign-in redesigns historically show flat results.
Target step drops 35% of users, but major screen redesigns in late funnel carry high risk.
Low cost hint addition addressing 3 support emails on photo quality.
Directly tackles 2336s mean wait time during pet creation without full home redesign.
Resolves user confusion reported in support emails, but checklist layout adds user friction.
